# Motor Database

> Open, community-maintained specifications of brushless motors (mostly FPV drone motors): stator size, KV, internal resistance, weight, shaft, bearings, mounting, price and product links.

The website (index.html) is an interactive table that needs JavaScript. The same data is published as static files:

- [database.json](database.json): every motor, one object per KV version. Fields and units are described in motor.schema.json. All values are strings; "" means unknown. "_file" is the source file in the GitHub repository.
- [database.csv](database.csv): the same rows as CSV.
- [motors.html](motors.html): the same rows as a plain HTML table (no JavaScript).
- [motor.schema.json](motor.schema.json): field definitions and units.

Values are the manufacturers' published specifications (product pages, spec sheets, product photos), not independent measurements.

## Linking to a filtered view

The interactive table reads filters from the URL:

- `?search=2306 1950kv`: search all fields (every word must match)
- `?<column>=<value>`: filter one column; the parameter is the column label in snake_case, e.g. `manufacturer`, `name`, `size`, `kv`, `price`, `stator_diameter`, `stator_height`, `stator_configuration`, `internal_resistance`, `weight_incl_cable`, `magnet_type`
- Number columns take an exact value or a range: `1950`, `>1900`, `<=30`, `1700-2000`. `size` is the 4-digit stator code: `?size=2207` is exact, `?size=22` matches every size containing "22", `?size=2207-2306` is a range.
- `?sort=kv` or `?sort=-price` (descending)

Example: `?manufacturer=T-Motor&kv=1700-2000&size=>=2207&sort=price`

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/marc-frank/motor-database): one JSON file per motor model in motors/<Manufacturer>/
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/marc-frank/motor-database/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
